items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I do between one and two records a year for them. They promote my records... they are the sweetest, nicest people in the world

ctx.x: Exactly. I’m lucked into a wonderful situation with a label in Germany.

Nagel-Heyer, yeah. And they have been wonderful to me. I do between one and two records a year for them. They promote my records, they do all they can, they spend a lot of money in advertising, they hired Allegro Distribution to distribute the records all through so they’re now like in Borders bookstores and Sound Warehouse and Tower Records and all these places. I mean I can’t say enough good things about them, they are the sweetest, nicest people in the world, and they are just trying to promote good music on…
